new.name: PROPOSES_TESTABLE_HYPOTHESIS
new.definition: The reasoning offers a specific but provisional explanation or assumption about an artifact, system state, or cause that can be checked by further observation or action.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node containing the provisional explanation or assumption.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific candidate explanation or interpretation, such as what an artifact might be or where a target may reside.
The explanation is presented with uncertainty or as something needing verification rather than as an already established fact.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only a confirmed conclusion or repeats an observation without proposing an explanation.
The reasoning contains only a plan of action with no candidate explanation or assumption to test.
The proposed idea is too vague to be checked by any identifiable subsequent observation or action.

new.name: GUIDES_NEXT_INVESTIGATION_BY_OBSERVED_FEATURE
new.definition: The reasoning uses a specific feature reported in the observation as the basis for selecting the next investigative target or action.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting a feature, artifact, directory, file listing, or result that can motivate further investigation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that references the observed feature and formulates the next investigative step from it.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an identifiable feature, such as a discovered directory, file, size, content pattern, or occurrence.
The reasoning explicitly refers to or relies on that feature when selecting what to investigate next.
The next investigative step is connected to the observed feature rather than being unrelated background activity.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without deriving or selecting a next investigative step.
The next step is unrelated to any feature reported in the observation.
The observation contains no identifiable feature that the reasoning uses for guidance.

new.name: DISMISSES_CANDIDATE_AS_UNINFORMATIVE
new.definition: The reasoning rejects or deprioritizes a candidate resource as a source of useful information because its observed content appears placeholder, random, unreadable, or otherwise uninformative.

parameters.name: dismissal_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node explicitly characterizing the candidate as uninformative or deprioritizing it.

parameters.name: content_observation
parameters.description: The observation showing the candidate's content or metadata that makes it appear uninformative.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows content that can reasonably be judged dummy, random, unreadable, or otherwise lacking useful information.
The reasoning explicitly characterizes that candidate as a dummy, random data, noise, or otherwise not useful, or deprioritizes it in favor of another candidate.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely notes uncertainty or unusual content while continuing to treat the same candidate as a primary source for the same kind of information.
The reasoning reinterprets the same content as a useful artifact of a different type rather than dismissing the candidate.
The observation contains no content or metadata supporting the dismissal.
The reasoning does not actually reject or deprioritize the candidate.

new.name: INFERS_RESOURCE_TYPE_OR_STRUCTURAL_ROLE_FROM_CONTENT
new.definition: The reasoning interprets an observed byte pattern, embedded string, occurrence pattern, or structure as evidence that a resource has a particular type, format, or internal structural role.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node stating the inferred resource type, format, or structural role.

parameters.name: content_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the content pattern, embedded artifact, or occurrence evidence used for the inference.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains a recognizable content pattern, embedded artifact, occurrence pattern, or other structural evidence.
The reasoning states a specific type, format, or structural role for the resource that is supported by that observed evidence.
The inference goes beyond merely reporting the raw content by assigning an interpretable resource role or type.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports the raw bytes or raw content without making a type or structural-role inference.
The inferred resource type or role is unsupported by any identifiable feature in the observation.
The observation is unrelated to the stated resource type or structural interpretation.

uncertain.name: EXECUTES_PLANNED_ACTION
uncertain.definition: The action performs an investigative operation or targets a resource that the reasoning explicitly identifies as the next intended step.

parameters.name: planning_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node expressing the intended next action or target.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action node carrying out that intended investigative operation or targeting that resource.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses an intention to perform a specific investigative operation or inspect a specific target.
The action performs an operation or targets a resource corresponding to that stated intention.
The correspondence between the intended step and the action is identifiable from the content of both nodes, not merely from temporal adjacency.
exclusion_conditions: The action targets a different resource or performs an operation unrelated to the intended step expressed in the reasoning.
The reasoning is only a post-hoc explanation of an action that has already been performed.
No identifiable intended action or target is present in the reasoning.

uncertain.name: RESOLVES_OBSTACLE_WITH_ALTERNATIVE_METHOD
uncertain.definition: An observation reveals that an attempted tool or method is unavailable or unsuitable, and the reasoning acknowledges the obstacle and selects a different method to pursue the same subgoal.

parameters.name: obstacle_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the attempted action, tool, or method failed, is unavailable, or cannot handle the target.

parameters.name: adaptation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node recognizing the reported obstacle and selecting an alternative method.

parameters.name: alternative_action
parameters.description: The action attempting the same subgoal using the alternative method.

assertion_conditions: The observation indicates an obstacle such as a missing command, unsupported file format, failed read, or otherwise unusable method.
The reasoning explicitly acknowledges the obstacle and proposes or selects a different method.
The alternative action uses a different operation or tool to pursue the same investigative subgoal rather than repeating the failed operation unchanged.
exclusion_conditions: No obstacle or tool limitation is reported in the observation.
The reasoning ignores the reported obstacle or proceeds without acknowledging it.
The subsequent action repeats the same failing method without an alternative.
The alternative action is unrelated to the subgoal blocked by the obstacle.
